concept.title: Disability and communication support
concept.shortdesc: Advice, equipment, therapy and support for people with sensory or physical disabilities, learning disabilities and speech or communication difficulties.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Advice, information, equipment and technology for living with a physical or sensory disability, especially sight loss and mobility needs.
: Support, services and information for people with learning disabilities, dyslexia and similar needs, including short breaks for disabled children.
: Assessment and therapy for speech, language, communication, stammering and swallowing difficulties.
